title: LLM Capability Limits: Static Emergence and Dynamic Boundary Control
abstract: arXiv:2608.01548v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Test-time emergence in LLM systems has a deployment boundary: additional computation can realize decisions already supported by the deployed information--execution structure, while evidence, tools, memory, and executable semantics can change the class inherited by later computation. We formalize this boundary through inherited structural capability $\mathcal{D}_{\mathcal{J}}$ and resource-indexed finite realization $\mathcal{F}_s(\mathcal{J},M)$. At a common budget, Theorem 1 gives an exact decision representation: a successor improves every bounded-loss task exactly when its closed convex finite envelope retains the predecessor's. Terminal capability can therefore expand while same-budget capability strictly reverses. The same object yields finite-slice recovery and a workload-tail information radius for open-ended evaluation. translated_title: 大语言模型能力极限：静态涌现与动态边界控制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.01548v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：大语言模型系统中的测试时涌现具有部署边界：额外的计算可以实现已由部署信息-执行结构支持的决策，而证据、工具、记忆和可执行语义可以改变后续计算所继承的类别。我们通过继承的结构能力$\mathcal{D}_{\mathcal{J}}$和资源索引的有限实现$\mathcal{F}_s(\mathcal{J},M)$来形式化这一边界。在共同预算下，定理1给出了精确的决策表示：当且仅当后继者的闭凸有限包络保留前驱者的闭凸有限包络时，后继者改善每个有界损失任务。因此，终端能力可以扩展，而同预算能力则严格逆转。同一对象产生了有限切片恢复和用于开放式评估的工作负载定制信息半径。动态上，贝尔曼价值为后继能力类别及其预选的有限策略定价。
tldr: 本文形式化了LLM系统测试时涌现的部署边界，通过继承结构能力和资源索引有限实现，证明了在固定预算下能力扩展与逆转的精确条件，并引入了动态价值定价机制。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes the deployment boundary of test-time emergence in LLM systems, proving exact conditions for capability expansion versus reversal under fixed budgets via inherited structural capability and resource-indexed finite realization, while introducing a dynamic Bellman value pricing mechanism.
